card.name: Self-reliance and not needing others
card.fires_on: Words in advice or opinion text about doing things on one's own terms, such as 'compete with themselves', 'we don't have to', or 'don't worry'. It fires on the word after phrases of independence, freedom from outside standards, or no need.

modes.label: Competing only with oneself
modes.description: Words right after 'compete' that point back to the self.

modes.label: No need or don't worry
modes.description: Verbs or 'to' after a negation that says something is not required.

modes.description: Words about setting aside outside norms or finding one's own rules.
